Add a Formulaic headings class to the skill catalogue (#291)

Close TODO 305 (maintainer decision Entry 242). "Why this matters" is
a common generated heading that readers dislike, and the skill did not
catch it: the catalogue had no rule about headings.
references/anti-patterns.md gains a Formulaic headings section between
Formulaic contrast and Manufactured cadence, and the Density section
of references/qa-checklist.md gains 1 matching question.

The 2 additions add 345 characters to the full download, which would
then hold 29268 characters against its 29000 label. 11 trims in
SKILL.md and anti-patterns.md remove 273 characters of redundant or
filler wording and change no rule and no catalogue entry, so the full
download and its 29k twin hold 28995. The 11k and 8k downloads each
name the new class and trim the same number of characters elsewhere,
so they stay at 10998 and 7996.

The full downloads, the checklist and instructions pages and the
sitemap are regenerated, and the skill-source hash is re-recorded.
The checklist and instructions pages, whose content changed, now carry
a modified date of 2026-11-27, so the page metadata gate accepts them.
The version stays 1.0.15.
